cards.subject: a bright, calm room for a child aged 2 to 4, with a tower of wooden blocks on a rug
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A soft oval natural wool rug lies on the floor with a small tower of plain wooden blocks and a few loose blocks on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low pale-wood open shelf with a few wooden animals and picture books (everything under 70 cm), and above it one small framed line drawing. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the RIGHT make soft dappled shadows on the floor. At the left edge of the frame an open white door leads into the room; a toddler girl of about two and a half in a sunny ochre knit sweater and cream trousers has just come through it and stands two steps inside the room at the left edge of the frame with her back to the camera, in mid-stride with both arms swinging out to the sides, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: pale wood, soft sage, white and warm grey.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

cards.subject: a calm, sunny room for a school-age child (6 to 10 years) with a low reading nook
cards.scene: A bright room with a light oak floor. A large round natural wool rug lies on the floor with two oat-coloured floor cushions on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low solid-oak bench (40 cm high) with a cream cushion and a few picture books, and above it one small framed pressed-leaf print. Warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the LEFT lies in long soft patches across the floor. A schoolboy of about eight in a muted denim-blue knit sweater and cream trousers stands on the floor in the middle of the room about two and a half metres in front of the mural wall with his back to the camera, both arms raised high above his head in delight, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: warm greige, oat, light oak, cream and soft terracotta.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A toddler girl of about two and a half in a sunny ochre knit sweater and cream trousers, standing just inside the open doorway at the left edge of the frame with her back to the camera, runs a few quick happy steps across the floor toward the mural wall and stops about two metres in front of it; on the last step both arms rise high above her head in delight and she stands still. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. The white door stays exactly as it is, open. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A schoolboy of about eight in a muted denim-blue knit sweater and cream trousers stands with his back to the camera in front of the mural wall, both arms raised. Slowly and calmly he takes two small steps toward the wall, his left arm lowers to his side, and his right hand comes to rest lightly on the wall and moves slowly along it from the giraffe toward the elephant, as if stroking the painted animals. His body moves very little, the movement stays gentle and unhurried, and he stops at the wall. His face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen. The rug and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
